THE PILGRIM ROAD. THREE VOICES, AND NOT ONE OF THEM MENTIONS NERAVOSS. That is the whole tonal rule of the Ascent and it is canon's: the story climax has happened, this is the personal one, and the region has gone back to being a region. These are three people who have jobs on a mountain. The player has just saved Caelora and nobody up here is going to bring it up, which is a far better way of saying it is over than having somebody say it is over.

The road warden at the gate is the exception that proves it -- he has heard, obviously everyone has heard, and what he actually wants to talk about is the road being open again.

lines: Four miles. Twenty-two on the road today and you are the twenty-third.
That is a normal number. It has not been a normal number since the summer.
The gate is open, the road is dry and there is a full moon on Thursday.
I have been sweeping this apron for nine days with nobody to sweep it for.
It went in March. Both posts still standing and forty feet of deck in the pool.
The city voted the money in April. They will vote it again next April.
Ford is up there. It has been the ford since before there was a bridge.
Sixty feet of fall coming into it and the top six inches never move. Explain that.
There is an islet out in the middle with a cairn on it. Somebody built that.
Not from here they did not. Nobody has been out there in my lifetime.
